name: x-train-route-22
objective: AN EXPERIMENT, NOT A LINK. The same job as link 11 - raise the lead to level 10 before Viridian Forest - done in the grass on Route 22, west of Viridian City, to measure whether anywhere pre-forest trains faster than Route 1 does.
evidence: An experiment. Route 22's grass is two blocks of 20 tiles at rows 8-11 of map $21, x=16-21 and x=30-33, found by reading the tileset's own grass tile ($52) out of the block map. Its encounter table averages 27.0 experience against Route 1's 25.0, and its nearest grass is 43 steps from the Viridian nurse against Route 1's 25 and Route 2 south's 56 - so the geometry alone cannot settle it, which is why it is run rather than inferred.
